defaultValue:
Colonies can grow to size 10 on their own. Past size 10 only a colony governed by an Omega core keeps growing, up to size 15, and every size takes longer to reach than the last.

A colony past size 10 becomes an Arcology World, at size 13 an Ecumenopolis, and at size 15 a Hyper-Ecumenopolis with an orbital ring.

fieldName: Size limit without an Omega core
fieldDescription: How big a colony can grow without an Omega core as its administrator. The base game stops at 6.
Each size past 10 takes this many times longer to reach than it normally would, on top of the size before it. At 1.5, size 11 takes 1.5 times as long, size 12 2.25 times, size 13 3.4 times.

fieldName: Stop AoTD economy doubling at size 10
fieldDescription: AoTD - Theory of Toolbox doubles a colony's food demand, domestic goods demand and farm output with every size. With this on, the doubling stops at size 10 and the colony grows like any other past it, so one size 15 world cannot outweigh the rest of the Sector. Does nothing without Theory of Toolbox.

defaultValue:
Destroyed Omega ships can drop the Omega core that commanded them. Bigger ships drop it more often.

If Omega Core Everywhere is installed, its drop settings are used and these two do nothing.

fieldDescription: Destroyed Omega ships can drop their Omega core.
Chance that a destroyed Omega frigate drops its core. Destroyers, cruisers and capitals multiply it by 2, 3 and 4.
